items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: He was close to Walker D.

ctx.x: It was calling you to tell us what I wanted to do then? Not then.

It was calling me Little Logan Henry then, but I was dancing then. I didn't quit dancing yet. But when Jimmie Height bought this piano and put it downstairs, they used to play this hymn for his mother-in-law. She was sick. He was close to Walker D. She liked it so well to, I used to have to play that to embrace her. She was a sick woman. And after I played that for her, I could play what I wanted from then on. And that's really where I really started putting what I wanted together right there in Jimmie Height.…
And you think back, they were calling you Professor Longhand when I used to follow him.
